title: Glutathione Cream vs Glass Glow Cream: Which One Should You Pick?
ex: Both Mirc Glow 30 g creams contain glutathione. Here is how they differ in ingredients, price per month and skin type, and who should pick which.
rt: Glutathione Cream vs Glass Glow Cream | Mirc Glow
rd: Glutathione cream vs Glass Glow Cream: ingredients, price per gram and per month, who should pick which, using both, and where the Night Duo fits.
keyword: glutathione cream vs glass glow cream
quick: Glutathione Cream (₹1,499) pairs glutathione with vitamin C and kojic acid for a radiant-looking finish on dull skin. Glass Glow Cream (₹2,499) adds hydration, a calm feel and alpha arbutin, with no kojic acid. Pick Glutathione Cream for dullness on a budget, Glass Glow for dry, uneven or kojic-sensitive skin.
facts: Both are 30 g and contain glutathione and niacinamide
Glutathione Cream has kojic acid; Glass Glow Cream has none
Use one per night, not both, with sunscreen every morning
